This confirms everything. Both pipelines failed in under 2 seconds — they never even started executing. The error is a Konflux infrastructure issue: the pipeline resolver couldn't clone the `stolostron/konflux-build-catalog` repo (got HTTP 403). And other recent PRs (#8957, #8954, #8953) have these same checks **passing**, confirming this is a transient infrastructure issue unrelated to the PR's code changes. # Test Failure Analysis Complete ## Job Information - **Prow Job**: Red Hat Konflux / hypershift-cli-mce-50-on-pull-request, Red Hat Konflux / hypershift-release-mce-50-on-pull-request - **Build ID**: `hypershift-cli-mce-50-on-pull-request-z6vmb`, `hypershift-release-mce-50-on-pull-request-qtps2` - **PR**: [#8866](https://github.com/openshift/hypershift/pull/8866) — [CNTRLPLANE-3616](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/CNTRLPLANE-3616): setting min-tls-version for the konnectivity-server container - **Namespace**: crt-redhat-acm-tenant - **Failed at**: 2026-07-08T07:09:22Z (both pipelines failed within 2 seconds of starting) ## Test Failure Analysis ### Error ``` Error retrieving pipeline for pipelinerun crt-redhat-acm-tenant/hypershift-cli-mce-50-on-pull-request-z6vmb: resolver failed to get Pipeline : error requesting remote resource: error getting "Git" "crt-redhat-acm-tenant/git-38d76812fbf1d781d4be0475339c0aaf": error resolving repository: git clone error: Cloning into '/tmp/konflux-build-catalog.git-2111985784'... fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/stolostron/konflux-build-catalog.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403: exit status 128 ``` ### Summary Both Konflux pipeline runs (`hypershift-cli-mce-50-on-pull-request` and `hypershift-release-mce-50-on-pull-request`) failed before any pipeline tasks could execute. The Tekton pipeline resolver was unable to clone the `stolostron/konflux-build-catalog` Git repository due to an HTTP 403 (Forbidden) error. This is a transient Konflux infrastructure authentication/authorization issue — the pipelines failed within 2 seconds of starting, meaning no build, test, or compilation logic was ever reached. The PR's code changes (setting min-tls-version for konnectivity-server) are completely unrelated to the failure.
Root Cause The root cause is a **transient Konflux infrastructure failure** in the Tekton pipeline resolver's ability to access the `stolostron/konflux-build-catalog` Git repository on GitHub. **Failure chain:** 1. Konflux triggers the pipeline runs for PR #8866 2. The Tekton pipeline resolver attempts to resolve the pipeline definition from the `stolostron/konflux-build-catalog` Git repository 3. The Git clone operation receives an **HTTP 403 (Forbidden)** response from GitHub when accessing `https://github.com/stolostron/konflux-build-catalog.git/` 4. The resolver fails, and the entire pipeline run is aborted before any tasks execute **Why this is transient infrastructure, not a code issue:** - The `stolostron/konflux-build-catalog` repository is **public** (confirmed via GitHub API — `visibility: "public"`, not archived, not disabled) - Other recent PRs in the same repo (#8957, #8954, #8953) have these identical Konflux checks **passing successfully** - Both pipelines failed in **under 2 seconds** — no build or test code was ever executed - The 403 error is characteristic of a transient GitHub token/credential expiry or rate limiting within the Konflux service account used by the `crt-redhat-acm-tenant` namespace
Recommendations 1. **Re-trigger the Konflux checks** — Since this is a transient infrastructure issue, simply re-running the pipelines should resolve it. Push an empty commit or use the Konflux UI to re-trigger the pipeline runs. 2. **No code changes needed** — The PR's changes (setting min-tls-version for the konnectivity-server container) are entirely unrelated to the failure. The pipeline never reached the point of building or testing code. 3. **If re-trigger fails again** — Report to the Konflux/ACM infrastructure team that the pipeline resolver's GitHub credentials for the `crt-redhat-acm-tenant` namespace are intermittently returning 403 errors when accessing `stolostron/konflux-build-catalog.git`.
